subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Is the current source evidence enough to sponsor a Feishu resolver repair now, or should maintainers require a latest-release/current-main Feishu live repro with vendor diagnostics before adopting or replacing the linked PR?
rationale: The code path is suspicious but not conclusive: current source includes `receive_id_type`, the reporter's manual API call also failed, and the open fix candidate is conflicting and unproven.

options.title: Require current-main Feishu proof
options.body: Ask for a latest-release or current-main Feishu send log with vendor code and log_id before reviving or replacing the linked PR.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR direction

options.title: Sponsor a narrow replacement after proof
options.body: If fresh diagnostics prove invalid target classification, close the fork and sponsor one focused Feishu resolver fix.
